signal.rationale: Firm ONGC order of 44.66 crore incl. GST, about 37.8 crore ex-GST or 59% of TTM revenue of 64.13 crore. It is not routine: it is roughly 1.7 times the prior high of about 26 crore and comes from a new customer. The company is profitable, so no stressed-company disqualifier applies, but TTM operating margin of 9.4%, falling revenue and an unresolved preferential issue are open questions for deep research.
